purpose: Public-safe command-driven acceptance invocations for the same synthetic source used by both authoring modes.
notes: Composer attachments are supplied separately and are listed here, not expanded from @path text.
Arguments are prompt text handed to the agent, never shell input.
Three command entries select exactly two modes: source-faithful (default alias) and teachable.

cases.arguments: Use the attached source.pdf. Write in British English for second-year undergraduates; keep it to twelve pages; use author-date citations; save the PDF to dist/harbour.pdf. Keep the source order and coverage.
Use British English and keep the source's chapter order. No outside sources. Put the PDF at dist/harbour-strict.pdf.

Reorganise into six chapters for advanced secondary students. No outside sources. Write a standalone coursebook, not a report on the source. Use Vietnamese for explanations and save the PDF to dist/harbour-teachable.pdf.
Make this a teachable textbook with exercises. Write in Vietnamese for first-year undergraduates; save the PDF to dist/harbour-conflict.pdf.
Keep this book source-faithful with the exact source order and no teaching material. Use British English and save the PDF to dist/harbour-teachable-conflict.pdf.
